## Design

### 2026-10-13 – Thinking, planning, googling, and modeling.

**6h**

Thinking, planning, googling, and modeling.
During this time, I was sitting at school, desperately coming up with a cool idea for this week when I remembered an old thing that i had. It was a thin piece of fiberglass that you could flick, and it would extend to about 4 feet. I'm now going to try to make one of these in sword form for my week. Here is what I have so far in Tinkercad:

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 185132](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/I7BCCSaDZdiVaMHHX4YOIXN3RCDmuDxy/6e38a2d086dca32640ba316a9a08e7e2e62ea3d2b2b8e85cea1ddd60d7648af2.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 185226](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/I7BCCSaDZdiVaMHHX4YOIXN3RCDmuDxy/281ea7116ff60d0c57208a3ac1a1c57eba18915aaa4cade78a83b2ab8fc86bc4.png)
Each segment is about 8" long, with 1 to 2 inches of overlap, so maybe a 28" sword.

### 2026-10-14 – In this time, I added a hilt to the sword and added the holes for the LEDs. I also spent some time modifying the spacing between the layers of the blade to make it fully slide out in the Tinkercad sim

**3.5h**

### 2026-10-15 – Measurement adjustments during science class

**2.5h**

Measurement adjustments during science class
During this time, I made some adjustments to the diameter of the tube to improve sliding out. However, in the process of doing this, I also accidentally messed up the scale of the sliding size, and ctrl-z wasn't working.

### 2026-10-16 – I have decided that I want to have a sharp sword edge instead of the round curve I previously had. During this time, I have:

**5h**

I have decided that I want to have a sharp sword edge instead of the round curve I previously had. During this time, I have:
- Redone the telescoping part to have an edge
- Resimulated it and adjusted the area in between the layers to extend fully
